title: feat: create Claude port-widget skill package
body:
Summary

* create a repo-local Claude skill package for `port-widget` under `.claude/skills/port-widget`
* add the skill instructions, agent metadata, flavor-specific references, and a widget coverage audit script
* keep the repo package Claude-only; Codex can use a symlink or separate mirror if needed

Testing

* `PYTHONPATH=/tmp/codex-pyyaml python3 /Users/aymeric.giraudet/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py .claude/skills/port-widget`
* `python3 .claude/skills/port-widget/scripts/audit_widget_coverage.py filter-suggestions related-products chat`
